patches.title: Ordered Search for Cleaning
patches.principle: Scan all open surfaces first, then check fridge for food items, then open cabinets for other objects.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for a cleanable object and open surfaces are exhausted.

patches.title: Avoid Premature Container Opening
patches.principle: Do not open containers until all open surfaces in the current area have been examined.
patches.when_to_apply: When target object is not immediately visible on arrival.

patches.title: Direct Sink After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up a dirty object, go directly to the sink without detouring.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning.
